parameters.name: native-site-editor-techies
parameters.description: Browser-native site editor for selected techiesreviews repositories

manual_checks: GitHub App is public (a private App can be installed and authorized only by its owner, so every other account gets a 404 at GitHub's sign-in).

Repository permissions are Contents: Read and write, Metadata: Read-only, Actions: Read-only and Checks: Read-only (for the Change status after a save: workflow runs, and the check runs of hosts such as Cloudflare Workers Builds), Administration: Read and write (so Get started can create the user's repository), Pages: Read and write (Publish turns on GitHub Pages and sets its custom domain), Workflows: Read and write (Publish saves the deploy workflow), Secrets: Read and write (Publish stores a Cloudflare or Spacefast key as a repository secret and lists secret names), Commit statuses: Read-only and Deployments: Read-only (Publish shows a host's live address).
Request user authorization (OAuth) during installation is on: installing the App also signs the user in, through /auth/install and /auth/callback (the setup URL is then ignored by GitHub).
